differentialexpression, transcript discovery, splice variants, allele-specific expression

1) Raw-data: Short sequence reads
2) Mapping: splice junctions
3) Summarize: counting over exons vs counter over genes: Table counts (abundance)
4) DE: filtering out lowly expressed genes: cut-offs, iterative. Normalisation: sequencing depth, TMM bias and Batch effects.
   1) Models the counts directly: Negative binomial: edgeR, DESeq/2
   2) Transform the counts: voom
5) Pathway analysis
